notes.note: Reviewed exact-page-origin publication reads before browser identity binding. Authenticated same-origin reads expose settings only; route learning still requires the saved matching environment identity. Native and remote unidentified profiles remain excluded. Live Windows HTTPS reproduction and red-to-green route query test cover the change.
